description: This SCSS file defines mixins for a grid system, including row, column, and CSS Grid utilities, supporting responsive breakpoints and gutter configurations.

methods.name: make-row
methods.description: Creates a flexbox row with configurable gutter spacing, setting up flex wrapping, margins, and CSS variables.

methods.name: make-col-ready
methods.description: Prepares columns with box-sizing, width, and padding styles to ensure proper sizing within the grid.

methods.name: make-col
methods.description: Defines column styles based on size, adjusting flex and width properties accordingly.

methods.name: make-col-auto
methods.description: Sets a column to auto width with flex and width properties.

methods.name: make-col-offset
methods.description: Creates column offset by applying margin-left based on the provided size and number of columns.

methods.name: row-cols
methods.description: Sets a parent element to arrange children into a specified number of columns with flex.

methods.name: make-grid-columns
methods.description: Generates grid-based column classes for different breakpoints, supporting auto columns, row columns, offsets, and gutters.

methods.name: make-cssgrid
methods.description: Generates classes for CSS Grid layout with configurable columns and breakpoints.
